issue_context.title: Ondilo ICO large scan interval leads to results sometime way off real measurement time
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The Ondilo ICO component uses a scan interval of one hour. Maybe because of the fact that the device only does a measurement once every hour.
But this can lead to a big difference between the real measurement time and the time of values in HA as both intervals are not bound together.
The device's interval depends on when you turned it on and also is not really constantly one hour.
The interval in HA is from when you started the server.
For example if you started the device at 9:05 and HA at 9:55 then the next measurement is taken at ~10:05 while HA reads that at 10:55 and also uses that time to set the value read to the sensor.
So this is way off.

As the API of Ondilo allows a rate limit of requests of 5 per second or 30 per hour the minimum for the component would be every 2 minutes.
Taken into account that this is not needed and we don't have to max it out I suggest an interval of 5 minutes for the component.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.11.5

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

Home Assistant OS
